onboarding.b1: Read sensors, send commands and watch your microcontroller's signal in real time.
onboarding.b2: Classic Bluetooth, BLE or Wi-Fi. Connect without switching tools.
onboarding.b3: Drag to switch. The signal stays on screen while you type commands.
onboarding.b4: No account. Your readings and commands never leave your phone unless you ask.
onboarding.p1b: To find and connect Bluetooth modules. We don't use it to know where you are.
onboarding.p2b: To find and control modules on the same network as your phone.
onboarding.p3b: Readings and logs stay on your phone. With Premium, export CSV, TXT and images.
